t: Signature MAVLink Protocol Libraries: What MAVLink Is: The Vehicle's Language
title: Signature MAVLink Protocol Libraries: What MAVLink Is: The Vehicle's Language
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigLink protocol, Manon's original vehicle-link design. SigLink mirrors the heartbeat/telemetry/command vocabulary but every message carries a sequence and a MAC by default — signing is not optional. The Signature design makes unsigned messages a ground-station alarm, not a quiet acceptance.
key_facts: Binary protocol for vehicles and ground stations
v2 adds signing and bigger message space

t: Signature MAVLink Protocol Libraries: Heartbeat: The Link's Pulse
title: Signature MAVLink Protocol Libraries: Heartbeat: The Link's Pulse
description: SigLink's pulse is the drumbeat: 1 Hz, carrying mode, health, and a MAC. The Signature design treats drumbeat silence as a first-class event — the ground station's link-loss failsafe triggers on the drumbeat timeout, and the timeout is part of the signed link configuration, not a magic number.
